_comment: Which local axis of an IK chain's first joint should point at its pole target.
Maya decides this on its own - measured, the default is -Y. When the rig wants a
different one the tool corrects it with the handle's 'twist' attribute.
'twist' is the right lever: jointOrient does NOT work (the solver compensates and
the axis stays put), and rotate must never be used (the solver overwrites it every
evaluation). twist is stored in the file, so saving and then referencing keeps the
same axis - which is the whole point.
This is a list so more sets can be added later, each with its own axis.
